headlines.shortLinkText: Tua Tagovailoa leads TD drive and loses fumble in Falcons' 17-12 preseason win over Dolphins

headlines.shortLinkText: Miles Davis' TD run lifts Panthers to 16-13 win over Texans in preseason finale

headlines.description: — Seattle's Jason Myers missed a 52-yard field goal as time expired, and the Seahawks played to a 9-9 tie with the Kansas City Chiefs Friday night in a preseason matchup of rookie third-string quarterbacks.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seattle's Myers misses field goal as time expires and Seahawks play to 9-9 tie with Chiefs

headlines.description: — Veteran Josh Johnson threw for 156 yards in the first half, Evan McPherson kicked a 56-yarder for one of his three field goals and the Cincinnati Bengals capped a perfect preseason with a 30-13 victory over the Philadelphia Eagles on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Johnson helps Bengals conclude perfect preseason with 30-13 win over Eagles
